beats.text: In Finland, 100% of the poorest adults have an account. In Yemen, only 6.5% do.
In the USA, 95.6% of the poorest citizens hold an account, well above the global median.
India has 86.3%, counting anyone who used a bank, shared account, or mobile money service.
At the bottom, Madagascar has 14.1%, Pakistan has 13.6%, and Yemen has 6.5%.
Do the poorest adults in your country have bank accounts?
